faq.question: Can I record several founder videos in one visit?
faq.answer: Yes. Founder content works well in batches when the topics are prepared before the session. This can make one studio visit much more useful.

faq.question: Do I need a full script?
faq.answer: No. A full script is optional. Strong bullet points, clear messages and a simple recording flow are often better for natural founder-led content.

faq.question: Can Birdcast help me choose between podcast and short-form?
faq.answer: Yes. The team can help decide whether your topics are better as short clips, interview content, podcast-style conversations or a mixed session.

faq.question: Is this useful for LinkedIn?
faq.answer: Yes. Founder-led content can be shaped for LinkedIn posts, company pages, websites, newsletters and short social clips.

faq.question: What should I send before recording?
faq.answer: Send your topics, target audience, preferred tone, examples you like and whether you want long-form content, short clips or both.
